# Keep Panorama filter names and query data roles explicit

Current filter classes use descriptive UpperCamel names ending in Filter, such as SingleFolderFilter and TaggedMessagesFilter. The base keeps mSQLClause separate from mSQLParams, and interface methods use lowerCamel initWithFolder/initWithTag while C++ methods use their generated UpperCamel forms. Proposed naming pattern for this component: name the filter by the condition and keep the SQL text and bound-value roles distinct. Existing mixed-case test filenames test_liveView.js and test_sqlFunctions.js are registered as written; these examples do not define a project-wide file casing rule. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Panorama filter and test naming.
